reviewFailure.observed: Independent reviewer reported Road placement regression: expected road cell (98,182) absent. Earlier parcel checks passed.
reviewFailure.localReproduction: Not reproduced locally. Both full workflows passed with center clicks. Old boundary probes in the second run also picked the intended endpoints. Original failed run had no endpoint trace; its precise picked cells are unknown.
reviewFailure.diagnosis: Harness targeted exact cell boundaries. Projection rounds to integer screen pixels; CityTools.cursorPoint rounds the surface hit to half cells; RoadRoute.points floors to cells. A nearby half-cell pick can change the route row. Center clicks remove this ambiguity. No production defect was confirmed.
reviewFailure.fix: Only final road regression uses cell centers (80.5,182.5) and (116.5,182.5). Real xdotool clicks and exact assertion for road cell (98,182) remain. New sanitized endpoint/probe diagnostics and final capture are saved. Failure paths also save sanitized failure text and a final capture.
